title: Existence and positive Hölder minimizers for the two-phase Robin free-boundary energy with uniformly positive exterior Sobolev data
source_title: A two-phase problem with Robin conditions on the free boundary
author: Serena Guarino Lo Bianco; Domenico Angelo La Manna; Bozhidar Velichkov
difficulty_reason: A constrained approximation scheme, weighted-perimeter lower semicontinuity and a nonlinear coarea/isoperimetric nondegeneracy iteration establish minimizers without invoking an SBV compactness theorem.
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.139

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Only Theorem1.1(i)–(ii): beta>0, smooth bounded D in dimensiond≥2, exterior finite-perimeter set E and H1_loc data v≥m>0 with finite weighted boundary energy. Interior Hölder regularity and strictly positive lower bound are selected; no singular-set dimension or global boundary-Hölder claim. The entire approximating/limit construction and nondegeneracy core are included. General Lemma2.4 prints an L1 dominating function, but its applications here use the harmonic extension h, locally bounded and hence L2_loc, exactly the domination needed in its authored limit argument; no general L1-domination lemma is claimed. Bounded notation/display slips include divergence integrals over A instead of A∩E in2.3, beta omitted from one3.1 energy equality, and t²/2 rather than t²/4 in4.1 perimeter bound; explicit constructions use the correct sets/constants and no substantive core replacement is required.
